prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Extend the attached Money Stories UI v2 sketch reference into a living-landscape concept. Reference is style and navigation only; make scenery substantially larger, about upper 40% of each phone, with readable day-story card below. Landscape review board with FOUR complete tall phone sketches side by side. Warm white pencil paper, hand ink, gentle watercolor sage green and ochre, light blue river, readable large restrained typography. Rough thoughtful UX concept, not glossy final UI. Each phone top Money Stories, avatar D; Today and Jump to date controls; horizontal road with stone date markers and small traveller precisely at selected date; bottom Journey / + Record expense / Money. Clearly number and name each scenario ABOVE the phones, short designer annotation OUTSIDE below phones. Selected date explicitly printed above day card. Images should show tangible financial-event-driven scenery, not mere icons in cards. No penalties, dead trees, dry terrain, sad avatars, wealth scores, streaks, implied account balances or investment-return claims. Amounts fictional. Header "UI v2 · Living landscape" with board subtitle. Footer "Concept sketches · Sample data".
Subtitle "Every action leaves a trace". Four scenarios:
13 LOAN PAYMENT. Date Sep 15. Scenic winding road crosses a river on partially assembled stone bridge; show one new warm highlighted stepping stone added, remaining gap visibly unfinished. Traveller at Sep15 milestone before bridge. Compact bubble "Another step across". Main card "Loan payment recorded" "₹8,000 · 15 September" "View repayment history". A smaller activity line "Today's expenses · ₹650". Outside annotation "A confirmed repayment adds a stone; tap to see history".
14 FIRST INVESTMENT. Date Sep16. Same road with tiny newly planted sapling and little marker "First contribution"; subtle butterfly. Main card "Your first sapling" "₹2,000 investment recorded" "16 September" "View investment". Outside annotation "A new tree marks the first recorded contribution".
15 EVERYDAY LIFE. Date Sep17. Same warm healthy landscape, small market stall, modest home and bus stop appear beside road, no dryness. Label bubbles groceries / travel. Main card "Money supported your day" rows "Groceries ₹1,200" "Travel ₹180", "Recorded expenses ₹1,380", button "View 2 expenses". Outside annotation "Spending creates landmarks; normal expenses are not punished".
16 PREPARING AHEAD. Date Sep18. Road beside little shelter with partially completed roof, one newly added ochre roof tile. Main card "Preparing for car insurance" "₹5,000 set aside" "₹10,000 of ₹20,000 recorded saved" "Insurance payment still upcoming" button "View savings plan". Outside annotation "Roof grows with money set aside; the bill remains unpaid".
